items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I played Topeka, Kansas, and I played 'After You've Gone' and when Hot Lips Page got through playing, Lester Young stood up and took the second chorus on 'After You've Gone' ... I said, 'I'm not staying. I can't play with your band, Mr. Basie.'

ctx.x: HINTON: Played with Basie one night and quit.

I played Topeka, Kansas, and I played "After You've Gone" and when Hot Lips Page got through playing, Lester Young stood up and took the second chorus on "After You've Gone" and I went downstairs and refused to accept my money. I said, "I'm going back to Omaha to go back to school," and Basie begged me to stay. I said, "I'm not staying. I can't play with your band, Mr. Basie." My heart went in my mouth when Lester Young got up and took the second chorus on "After You've Gone" I died.
Now who was in this? This was a band that Basie had gotten from Bennie Moten and from Walter Page, and Walter Page came to get you, is that right?
